extracted.intended_audience: writers (novelists/long-form authors) in Australia and New Zealand seeking representation from Curtis Brown
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting a manuscript to the Curtis Brown literary agency (who accept submissions only during a specified open period). Covers eligibility, permitted formats, required materials, email/subject-line format, and response policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: What we want
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome submissions from any writer ... What we want, and hope to find are fresh, exciting new voices and work that demonstrates a commitment to the craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to both unpublished and previously self-published/established authors; agency seeks distinctive voice and craft. Does not guarantee representation — they are selective and currently taking on few new authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residency requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not submit manuscripts if you are not a resident of Australia or New Zealand
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions from non-residents will not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission window (timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Curtis Brown welcomes submissions during the month of June only. Submissions will open on the 1st of the month and will close on the last day of the month.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts received outside this window will be deleted without consideration or reply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres not considered
rubrics_metrics.description: We are currently unable to consider the following genres: stage/screenplay, poetry, self-help, children’s picture books, early reader books, middle-grade fiction, comics, short stories, cookbooks, educational, corporate, translated or comedy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your work falls into these categories, do not submit. The list is exhaustive for current exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No previously published / under-contract works
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note, we are unable to consider a work that is already published or is under contract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your manuscript has been published or is under contract elsewhere, it will not be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incomplete manuscripts
rubrics_metrics.description: If your manuscript is incomplete, please do not send sample chapters through
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only complete manuscripts should be submitted; partial/sample-chapter submissions for incomplete works are not acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hard copy submissions not accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not send hard copy submissions, your manuscript will not be considered nor will it be returned
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All submissions must be electronic via the specified email; mailed hard copies will be deleted/ignored and not returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript & synopsis formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Please format your manuscript and synopsis using double-spaced 12pt Times New Roman with 30mm margins
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both the manuscript and the synopsis must follow this formatting exactly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted file types
rubrics_metrics.description: Please only send Word or pdf files as we can not open other file types
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Other file formats will not be opened and such submissions risk deletion.

rubrics_metrics.name: One submission per writer per open period
rubrics_metrics.description: We will only accept one submission per writer during each open period; all subsequent submissions over this limit will be deleted without consideration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit multiple manuscripts or multiple emails during the same June window; only the first will be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party submissions prohibited
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not accept/consider submissions from third parties, any submission that is sent through a third party application or person will be automatically deleted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must submit directly yourself; agents, friends, or representatives may not submit on your behalf during the open period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email address for submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit to us please email submission@curtisbrown.com.au (note submission is singular)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the exact email address; failure to use this address may result in non-receipt. The page emphasizes the singular form of 'submission'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required subject-line format
rubrics_metrics.description: In the subject line of your email please put: YOUR NAME – MANUSCRIPT TITLE – FICTION/NONFICTION – GENRE
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided: 'JRR TOLKIEN – THE LORD OF THE RINGS – FICTION – FANTASY'. Follow this exact structure to help triage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional addressee
rubrics_metrics.description: You are welcome to address your email to The Submissions Department
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is optional and not required for consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover letter requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Please include a short cover letter in the body of your email (maximum 300 words). In this cover letter, please include: total word count of your manuscript; relevant biographical information - including previous writing experience & publishing history; your address & phone number
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cover letter must be concise (≤300 words) and must include word count, contact details, and relevant writing/publishing history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required attachments and length limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Please attach a short synopsis (maximum of 2 pages) and the first 3 chapters (or first 50 pages) of your manuscript formatted as per the guideline above.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach only the specified materials; the synopsis must be ≤2 pages and sample must be either first 3 chapters OR first 50 pages, formatted double-spaced 12pt TNR with 30mm margins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-compliant submissions deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: Any submissions that do not follow these guidelines will be deleted without reply
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strict enforcement: failure to meet any guideline (format, timing, filetype, attachments, residency, genre exclusions, multiple submissions, third-party submissions) risks deletion with no response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response time and follow-up
rubrics_metrics.description: We are currently taking up to 10 weeks to assess submissions (if your email sends successfully, please assume we have received it). If you don’t hear back from us within 10 weeks of sending your submission, please email us at submission@curtisbrown.com.au
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assume receipt if email sends; allow up to 10 weeks before following up via the same submission email.

rubrics_metrics.name: No feedback on rejections and no reading fee
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not offer specific comments on the manuscripts we reject and we will never charge a reading fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not expect editorial feedback on rejections; the agency will not charge for reading submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notify if other parties requesting manuscript or offering representation
rubrics_metrics.description: If other agencies or publishing houses have requested to read the full manuscript or have made you an offer of representation, please do let us know.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose competing interest/requests/offers when you submit; this may affect consideration/process.

rubrics_metrics.name: If interested: representation contact & standard agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: If we are interested in representing you we will contact you directly to discuss it and explain our standard agreement that sets out the author-agency relationship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency's agreement is based on taking a commission on income from projects they represent; they will explain terms upon contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current intake capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that to best care for our existing clients, we are taking on very few new authors at this time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a practical advisory: competition for acceptance is higher due to limited new-client intake.
